texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_CAUCASO_ATACANTE_: The mountaineers of the Caucasus have made this valley their fortress. Cross the gorge at the fords and give them no rest!
Our objective is the aul on the far slope. Take the village and hold it, and the valley is ours.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_CAUCASO_DEFENSOR_: The invaders have come up our valley. The gorge and the mountains fight with us: let them bleed at the fords!
Hold the aul at all costs. As long as the village is ours, every attack will break on our slopes.
